name: My Grimm Fate
source:
Born into a world where German fairytales and folklore come to life, you must find your own path. Will you claim your happily-ever-after, or meet a dark end worthy of the original Grimm tales? Discover your fate in this dark otome visual novel with multiple endings.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4049430/My_Grimm_Fate/?curator_clanid=45348664]Steam[/url]]
